page_review.title: Door
page_review.author: hoschu
page_review.download_modal_terms: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
page_review.visible_geometry: One purple four-panel leaf with an outer border and gold lever/plate on viewer left. The border initially resembled a frame in the remote view; inspect attempt 000001 shows it belongs to the same connected leaf mesh. No independent fixed jamb or hinge fitting is identified in the local component inventory.

license_dependency_review: The five 1K texture maps are packaged with the model; no separate creator or terms appear on the source page. Inspection reports no external dependencies, and USDZ metadata confirms the same hoschu, source URL and CC BY 4.0 license.
duplicate_remote_review: New source UID, author and purple four-panel design differ from the five accepted doors; inspect fingerprint confirms distinct geometry.
local_shape_review: Failed separable frame/panel filter: component 2 is one closed leaf and outer border, while components 0, 1 and 3 are all lever/plate geometry on the same edge. Assigning a fixed frame would move or freeze part of a single connected leaf.
